_about: Numbers cited by the public-robot-interaction-design kit. Every entry has 'class' = 'public' (a public paper, standard, regulation or physics arithmetic on public values; the source says which) or 'illustrative' (a round value of the same order of magnitude as a figure in the internal source documents, invented to teach a relation; never a measurement). No internal measurement is reproduced. 'my arithmetic' marks values derived from other entries. Some entries (gaze rates, timers, cones) are provided for the later rungs (diagram, explorer) and are not yet cited in a note. Load this file; do not retype the numbers.

turn_gap_typical.source: Stivers et al., 'Universals and cultural variation in turn-taking in conversation', PNAS 106(26), 2009: offsets between turns cluster around a short gap of about 200 ms across 10 languages

turn_gap_language_spread.unit: ms (range of language means around the cross-language mean)

turn_gap_japanese_mean.source: Stivers et al. 2009 (fastest language mean in the sample)

response_limit_flow.source: Nielsen, Usability Engineering, 1993, ch. 5: about 1 s is the limit for the user's flow of thought to stay uninterrupted; 0.1 s feels instantaneous; 10 s loses attention

gaze_listener_share.unit: fraction of listening time spent looking at the speaker
gaze_listener_share.source: Argyle & Ingham, 'Gaze, mutual gaze and proximity', Semiotica 6, 1972; summarised in Argyle & Cook, Gaze and Mutual Gaze, 1976 (commonly cited dyadic figures)

gaze_speaker_share.unit: fraction of speaking time spent looking at the listener

gaze_predicts_listened_to.unit: probability the person looked at is the person listened to
gaze_predicts_listened_to.source: Vertegaal, Slagter, van der Veer, Nijholt, 'Eye gaze patterns in conversations', CHI 2001

gaze_predicts_spoken_to.unit: probability the person looked at is the person spoken to

saccade_duration_intercept.source: Carpenter, Movements of the Eyes, 1988: saccade duration ~ 21 ms + 2.2 ms per degree (main-sequence approximation; Bahill, Clark & Stark 1975)

saccade_40deg_duration.source: my arithmetic from saccade_duration_intercept and saccade_duration_slope at 40 degrees

proxemics_personal.source: Hall, The Hidden Dimension, 1966: personal distance zone

speed_of_sound_20c.source: dry air at 20 degrees C (standard physics value)

tdoa_max_10cm.source: my arithmetic: 0.10 m / speed_of_sound_20c, the largest delay between two microphones 10 cm apart (sound arriving along the axis)

sample_path_16k.unit: cm of path difference per sample

one_sample_angle_10cm_16k.source: my arithmetic: asin(sample_path_16k / 10 cm); why integer-lag cross-correlation is coarse and sub-sample interpolation (GCC-PHAT peak interpolation) is used

spatial_alias_5cm.source: my arithmetic: f < c / (2 d) with d = 5 cm; above this a pair's phase difference wraps (spatial aliasing)

spatial_alias_10cm.source: my arithmetic: f < c / (2 d) with d = 10 cm

gdpr_child_consent_age_default.source: GDPR (Regulation (EU) 2016/679) Art. 8(1): default age for a child's own consent to information-society services; member states may lower it

gdpr_child_consent_age_floor.source: GDPR Art. 8(1): lowest age a member state may set

wcag_flash_limit.source: WCAG 2.2 Success Criterion 2.3.1 Three Flashes or Below Threshold

wcag_timing_extend_warning.unit: s (minimum warning before a time limit expires, for the 'extend' option)

kappa_substantial_floor.source: Landis & Koch, Biometrics 33, 1977: 0.61-0.80 'substantial' agreement (Cohen's kappa, Cohen 1960)

fisher_10of10_vs_5of10_p.source: my arithmetic: Fisher exact test on 10/10 vs 5/10 successes; even a perfect-versus-half split needs about 10 trials per arm to reach p < 0.05

fisher_5of5_vs_2of5_p.source: my arithmetic: Fisher exact test on 5/5 vs 2/5; small samples cannot show 'no effect'

preroll_bytes_1p5s_16k.source: my arithmetic: preroll_illustrative (1.5 s) x 16 000 samples/s x 2 bytes (16-bit mono)

attention_window_illustrative.source: illustrative; how long a passer-by gives a stand before judging it; keeps the order of the internal design figure

venue_noise_illustrative.source: illustrative; a loud public venue; keeps the order of the internal design figure

listening_indicator_budget_illustrative.unit: ms from consent action to visible listening signal
listening_indicator_budget_illustrative.source: illustrative design budget; chosen below response_limit_flow

listening_indicator_signal_illustrative.source: illustrative split; sums with listening_indicator_detect_illustrative to the budget

engagement_arc_illustrative.source: illustrative horizontal arc in front of the stand in which an approach counts

beat_reply_window_illustrative.source: illustrative listening-armed window after the greeting

beat_offer_illustrative.source: illustrative self-serve gift offer including the take timer

interaction_typical_illustrative.source: my arithmetic: sum of the six beat_*_illustrative values

interaction_cap_illustrative.source: illustrative 'chatty visitor' cap and session-lease maximum

per_turn_cap_illustrative.source: illustrative cap on one visitor turn

reset_turnover_illustrative.source: illustrative time to reset and let the next visitor step up

queue_friction_factor_illustrative.source: illustrative discount for crowd and queue friction

throughput_realistic_illustrative.source: my arithmetic: throughput_theoretical_illustrative x queue_friction_factor_illustrative, rounded

offerings_illustrative.unit: offerings (chat, a small gift, a photo)

wind_down_quiet_illustrative.source: illustrative quiet-listening time after which a supervisor infers 'conversation over'

doa_face_gate_illustrative.unit: degrees (nominal gate between a bearing and a face)

doa_effective_window_illustrative.unit: degrees either side (gate widened by bin uncertainty)
doa_effective_window_illustrative.source: my arithmetic, rounded: doa_face_gate_illustrative + half of doa_bin_illustrative

doa_hold_illustrative.source: illustrative maximum age of a held bearing

self_speech_tail_illustrative.source: illustrative suppression tail after the robot stops speaking (reverberation decay + label latency)

modal_bin_share_illustrative.unit: fraction of bearing samples in the modal bin
modal_bin_share_illustrative.source: illustrative acceptance rule for a per-turn modal bearing

voice_embedding_min_illustrative.source: illustrative minimum speech for a usable voice embedding; public speaker-verification work reports degradation for utterances of a few seconds or less

asd_min_face_illustrative.source: illustrative input-size gate of an active-speaker detector

face_median_low_res_illustrative.source: illustrative median face width at stand distance on a low-resolution stream

face_median_high_res_illustrative.source: illustrative median face width on a stream of twice the resolution

id_churn_token_cost_illustrative.unit: fractional increase in input tokens per response
id_churn_token_cost_illustrative.source: illustrative cost of a churning speaker-id stream to a speech-to-speech model

cascade_turns_illustrative.source: illustrative number of later turns that inherit one wrong bind through a 'last active speaker' fallback

label_t2_illustrative.source: illustrative voice-identity confirmation at or after end of turn

correction_rate_cap_illustrative.unit: minutes between identity corrections per visitor (at most one)

crowd_coarse_zone_illustrative.source: illustrative crowd size above which fine attribution falls back to coarse zones

gaze_band_listening_illustrative.unit: fraction of time looking at the addressee

gaze_band_speaking_illustrative.unit: fraction of time looking at the addressee

alternation_duty_illustrative.source: my arithmetic: gaze_episode_mean_illustrative / (gaze_episode_mean_illustrative + lookaway_mean_illustrative); inside the listening band, outside the speaking band

head_ema_alpha_illustrative.source: illustrative exponential smoothing of a head setpoint

head_ema_t95_illustrative.source: my arithmetic: ln(0.05) / ln(1 - head_ema_alpha_illustrative) / 50 Hz

face_challenger_margin_illustrative.unit: fractional size advantage a new face needs
face_challenger_margin_illustrative.source: illustrative hysteresis on the face selector

face_dropout_grace_illustrative.source: illustrative time a missing incumbent face is held at its last bearing

sector_glance_hold_illustrative.source: illustrative bearing stability needed before an off-camera glance

sector_glance_box_illustrative.source: illustrative time box for an off-camera acquisition glance

listening_timeout_illustrative.source: illustrative conversation-liveness timeout of the reasoner

idle_recentre_illustrative.source: illustrative idle recentre timer (later deleted in the design)

fov_default_illustrative.source: illustrative placeholder horizontal field of view left from a development webcam

fov_true_illustrative.source: illustrative true horizontal field of view of the head camera

fov_example_bearing_true.source: illustrative true bearing of a face used in the field-of-view example

fov_example_linear_wrong_fov.source: my arithmetic: pixel position of fov_example_bearing_true under a pinhole camera with fov_true_illustrative, converted back with the linear formula and fov_default_illustrative

fov_example_linear_right_fov.source: my arithmetic: the same pixel converted with the linear formula and fov_true_illustrative

linear_vs_pinhole_max_err_90.unit: degrees (largest near halfway to the edge)
linear_vs_pinhole_max_err_90.source: my arithmetic: max over u of atan(u tan 45 deg) - 45 u deg for a 90 deg field of view

looking_cone_illustrative.source: illustrative 'is looking at the robot' cone from a 3D head pose

barge_in_debounce_illustrative.source: illustrative debounce between a 'speech started' event and abandoning the robot's turn

vad_silence_short_illustrative.source: illustrative end-of-turn silence that fragments sentences

speech_burst_median_illustrative.source: illustrative median user speech burst between pauses

guard_subwindow_illustrative.source: illustrative sub-window of the spectral barge-in guard

guard_threshold_illustrative.source: illustrative decision threshold on the max sub-window speech-to-rumble ratio

guard_phantom_max_illustrative.source: illustrative highest score of motor-noise onsets in a fitted set

guard_real_min_illustrative.source: illustrative lowest score of real speech onsets in a fitted set

guard_tail_illustrative.source: illustrative motion tail after robot speech in which the guard is still consulted

guard_onset_grace_illustrative.source: illustrative 'self-hearing grace' after robot speech onset

proactive_greeting_illustrative.source: illustrative length of a perception-triggered greeting; shorter than guard_onset_grace_illustrative

self_hearing_lift_illustrative.unit: dB above the room floor on the processed channel during robot speech

self_hearing_leak_window_illustrative.source: illustrative window before late self-sound suppression engages

self_hearing_suppressed_drop_illustrativ.source: illustrative drop of the processed channel once suppression engages

actuator_lift_raw_illustrative.unit: dB (raw microphone, head moving vs holding)

actuator_lift_processed_illustrative.unit: dB (processed channel, head moving vs holding)
actuator_lift_processed_illustrative.source: illustrative; larger than actuator_lift_raw_illustrative because automatic gain control winds up

motion_over_speech_processed_illustrativ.unit: dB (robot's own motion louder than a nearby talker on the processed channel)

noise_only_transcripts_illustrative.source: illustrative: every noise-only clip sent to a transcription model came back as words

ghost_wake_relative_risk_illustrative.unit: x (false wake after a head move vs otherwise)

override_timeout_illustrative.source: illustrative hold time of a head-pose override at the motor arbiter

state_heartbeat_illustrative.source: illustrative republish period of the reasoner state

behaviour_ids_new_illustrative.unit: behaviour ids on the newer robot generation

behaviour_ids_old_illustrative.unit: behaviour ids on an older generation

dummy_success_latency_illustrative.source: illustrative return time of a dummy service that reports success without moving the robot

legacy_retry_turns_illustrative.source: illustrative bound on a planner's retry loop

reach_beat_scripted_illustrative.source: illustrative length of the longest scripted beat (a staged miss and recovery)

reach_beat_target_illustrative.source: illustrative autonomy target, half of reach_beat_scripted_illustrative

safety_trials_per_image_illustrative.source: illustrative; the image's grade is its worst trial

handover_error_target_illustrative.source: illustrative target error rate for a physical hand-over

dance_clearance_illustrative.source: illustrative clearance around a whole-body dance in the lab
